name: Agent Carousel Hero
description: A 'set up once, runs itself' hero with an auto-cycling expanding carousel of automation agents: four collapsed vertical cards (rotated name/role label + a token-SVG bust) and one expanded card showing an FluentCRM-style activity panel with a typewriter tooltip.
interactions: header + rail fade up on first view (IntersectionObserver adds .is-inview; wpmn-ach-up 600ms, rail staggered 120ms)
carousel auto-cycles: every 4600ms the next card opens (flex-grow/flex-basis/min-width 600ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)), the collapsed layer cross-fades out and the expanded layer fades in
clicking or pressing Enter/Space on a collapsed card opens it and restarts the cycle timer
the open card's tooltip types its data-type string char by char (32ms/char) with a blinking caret (wpmn-ach-caret 1s step-end)
cards lift their background on hover (120ms)
prefers-reduced-motion: no auto-cycle, no typing (full tooltip text shown), reveals and pulse rendered in final state
